requirements.statement: ARMv5TE DSP multiplies perform signed selected-halfword products for SMLAxy, SMULxy, and SMLALxy; SMLAWy and SMULWy multiply a signed word by a selected signed halfword and use product bits 47 through 16; SMLALxy accumulates a sign-extended product modulo 2^64.
SMLAxy and SMLAWy set the sticky CPSR Q flag on signed overflow of their 32-bit accumulation; SMULxy, SMULWy, and SMLALxy leave Q unchanged, and every DSP multiply leaves N, Z, C, and V unchanged.
